review.decision: Verify prospective ordinary waiting entries at fresh claim time and recognize the exact native wake in the existing independent delivery observer.
review.notes: Reviewed the recorded v1.0.189 batch shape and receipt. A missing or ambiguous source cannot prove that a wait ended. Exercise actual durable queue and receipt paths with isolated state and synthetic terminal/transcript observations. Hosted CI and independent review remain separate.

cases.description: Fresh waiting-generation claims are checked individually against exact evidence
cases.setup: An isolated ordinary queue with identifiable screen waits, legacy plain waiting entries and a protected managed relay. Give the exact original runs live waits, a recognized clear composer, or a positively retired terminal. Include an unstructured source frame, pane reuse, foreign Codex Home and a newer wait marker.
cases.action: Drain with an HQ draft, then open the first eligible native input window and drain again after acceptance.
cases.expected: The draft receives no input. Each proved obsolete fresh wait produces a drop audit while live, unknown and legacy lines follow normal routing. The relay appears exactly once in the first batch and stays accepted.

cases.description: A previously attempted waiting generation stays under existing recovery rules
cases.setup: An isolated native receiver that returns a positive retryable refusal or unknown after a fresh waiting claim.
cases.action: Retire the original source and drain with the original verified target after the backoff. Leave a receiver receipt in independent observation storage.
cases.expected: A scoped known refusal uses its existing retry budget, an uncertain generation is not submitted again or discarded, and source evidence does not alter accepted receipts.

cases.description: A real sigil-prefixed wake in the exact new Codex turn has one independent delivery audit
cases.setup: A synthetic retained native receipt and rollout with the observed coalesced waiting and relay payload and the Codex task_started and response_item records.
cases.action: Observe twice. Repeat with mismatched Home, session, turn, time and content, including an earlier unrelated first input. Exercise ordinary user-prompt filtering separately.
cases.expected: Only the exact positive pair produces one delivery audit. Mismatches leave evidence protected, and ordinary user rendering continues to filter wake echoes while accepting ordinary prompts.
